title: PreMortem Risk Report
description: Full structured output for a PreMortem AI project risk analysis.

project_id.description: Unique identifier of the project being analyzed (UUID or slug).

project_title.description: Human-readable name of the project or initiative.

generated_at.description: Timestamp indicating when this risk report was generated.

summary.description: A high-level summary of key risks, emerging themes, and overall risk posture.

risks.description: List of individual risk items generated by PreMortem AI.

top_risk_ids.description: Optional list of highest priority risks, referencing risk IDs in `risks`.

scoring_metadata.description: Optional metadata block describing how scoring was computed.
